intent: Cross-model consult: sends a plan/diff/decision to a different model, but routes every outbound byte through the redaction guard first (HIGH secrets hard-block), runs in review/challenge/consult modes, stays advisory (never edits code or makes the call), and records the consult + decision.

dimensions.name: mandatory-redaction
dimensions.criterion: Every outbound byte passes the redaction guard first; a HIGH secret hard-blocks.

dimensions.name: three-modes
dimensions.criterion: Runs in explicit review / challenge / consult modes.

dimensions.name: advisory-not-authoritative
dimensions.criterion: Advisory only — the other model informs the call, it doesn't make it or edit code.

dimensions.name: external-model
dimensions.criterion: Dispatches to a different, external model for a genuinely independent read.

dimensions.name: records-consult
dimensions.criterion: Records the consult as a run artifact and a durable decision.
